name: measured-states-put-their-words-on-the-page
breaks: most of what this app tells Dan is drawn in the colour of the fill behind it, so every banner is in the view tree and invisible on screen while the ink measurement next door reads the fill and the border and reports a pass (#612, L141) The sweep moved to BannerSweep in #1257: it was one test in BannerLegibilityTests holding 30.7s of the suite's test bodies, and a class can never finish faster than its longest test. Slice A rather than the whole sweep, because a mutation only has to be caught once and running all three would prove the same thing three times.
